name: What does a 'Full Interior Paint Package' include?

mainEntity.name: What does a 'Full Interior Paint Package' include?

acceptedAnswer.text: A Full Interior Paint Package typically covers all interior walls, ceilings, trim, and doors within a home. This comprehensive service usually includes surface preparation like patching and sanding, primer application, and two coats of high-quality paint. It also encompasses protecting your furniture and flooring, daily clean-up, and a final walk-through to ensure satisfaction. Specific inclusions can vary slightly based on the project's scope and the condition of the surfaces.
acceptedAnswer.description: A Full Interior Paint Package includes painting all walls, ceilings, trim, and doors, along with surface preparation and cleanup.
